title: Experiment run
description: One recorded run under experiments/<project-slug>/<run-id>/, separate from a single delivery's docs/<date>/<slug>/<version>/ tree and from .agent-state/ (ephemeral, ungeneralizable across runs). config.json and metrics.json each validate against the matching $defs entry here.

config.description: config.json: the inputs this run varied, so a later run-id can be diffed against it field by field.

model.description: Model name and version, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5" or a local checkpoint id.

dataset.description: Dataset name and version, when the run reads one.

hyperparameters.description: Free-form; whatever this run's method varies (learning rate, temperature, top_k, ...).

seed.description: Random seed, for reproducing this exact run.

metrics.description: metrics.json: the same {metrics, thresholds} shape experiment/METRICS.json already uses, so one parser reads both.

thresholds.description: Metric name to the comparison this run must meet, if any.

op.description: Matches exactly what runtime/internal/verifier/results.go's compareMetric implements. != is deliberately absent: the real comparator has no case for it and silently returns false, so a schema advertising it here would validate a threshold every future comparator would misread the same way.
